title: dbt Wizard: your AI teammate for data development
description:
Inside dbt Wizard, the AI agent for analytics engineers that validates changes, shows lineage-aware impact, and shows its work. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Sam Ferguson, product designer on dbt Wizard, and Ryan Eakman, senior staff software engineer at Fivetran, explain why analytics engineering needs an AI agent of its own. dbt Wizard validates every change against a development schema and shows its impact as a DAG, not a diff, so reviewers see what moved downstream before merging. It ships with dbt-specific tools, isolates schemas per work tree, and still supports skills. Design partners report a 15-20% reduction in production incidents. The session includes a live desktop app demo.

In this session you'll learn:
• How dbt Wizard validates changes and shows downstream impact
• Why a purpose-built agent differs from a general coding agent
• How teams use it in review workflows

Speakers: Sam Ferguson, dbt Labs; Ryan Eakman, Fivetran

Learn more about dbt Wizard: https://www.getdbt.com/product/dbt-wizard
